mapper.insert: INSERT INTO shipment ( order_code,shipment_code, warehouse_code, delivery_method, status, scheduled_date, total_cod_amount, receiver_name, receiver_phone,receiver_email, province_code, ward_code, address_detail, customer_note, created_at, updated_at,total_weight, length, width, height ) VALUES ( #{orderCode},#{shipmentCode}, #{warehouseCode}, #{deliveryMethod}, #{status}, #{scheduledDate}, #{totalCodAmount}, #{receiverName}, #{receiverPhone},#{receiverEmail}, #{provinceCode}, #{wardCode}, #{addressDetail}, #{customerNote}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,#{totalWeight}, #{length}, #{width}, #{height} )

INSERT INTO shipment_items ( shipment_id, sku_code, quantity, product_name ) VALUES
(#{item.shipmentId}, #{item.skuCode}, #{item.quantity},#{item.productName})
mapper.update: UPDATE shipment SET status = 'READY_TO_PICK', warehouse_code = COALESCE(warehouse_code, #{warehouseCode}), confirmed_by = #{confirmedBy}, confirmed_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'ON_HOLD'

UPDATE shipment SET status = 'PACKED', total_weight = #{totalWeight}, length = #{length}, width = #{width}, height = #{height}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'READY_TO_PICK'

UPDATE shipment SET status = 'DELIVERING', delivery_method = #{deliveryMethod}, partner_province_code = #{partnerProvinceCode}, partner_district_code = #{partnerDistrictCode}, partner_ward_code = #{partnerWardCode}, actual_shipping_cost = #{actualShippingCost}, tracking_number = #{trackingNumber}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'PACKED'
UPDATE shipment SET status = 'DELIVERED', updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'DELIVERING'

UPDATE shipment SET status = 'DELIVERED', delivery_method = 'PICKUP', confirmed_by = #{confirmedBy}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'READY_TO_PICK' AND delivery_method = 'PICKUP'
UPDATE shipment SET delivery_method = #{deliveryMethod}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id} AND status IN ('ON_HOLD', 'READY_TO_PICK')

UPDATE shipment SET delivery_method = 'PICKUP', partner_province_code = NULL, partner_district_code = NULL, partner_ward_code = NULL, tracking_number = NULL, actual_shipping_cost = 0, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id} AND status IN ('ON_HOLD', 'READY_TO_PICK')
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM shipment WHERE status != 'DELIVERED' AND order_code = #{orderCode}
